title: ends, before a quit resolves, what an engine left as it stopped as asked
why: A quit that does not wait for the engine's group (issue 640): the app exits before the kill is sent, and a tool that ignores SIGTERM outlives it.

title: ends, before a quit resolves, what an engine left as it stopped as asked
why: Only an exit nobody asked for has its group ended (issue 640): an engine that stops as asked, on a quit or after a failure, leaves its tools running past it.

title: keeps nothing for a group that was empty, before the stdio has closed
why: No look at the group as the exit is seen (issue 640): an empty one is kept and waited on until a later look, and its id can pass to another process before that look takes it for the engine's.

title: has a quit wait too for a group added while it waits
why: A wait that takes the groups there when it began (issue 640): an engine that outlived the kill and exits meanwhile leaves its group unwaited, and the quit resolves with it still running.

title: has read the last stderr line written before the pipe closed
why: The group signalled as the exit is seen, not once it is reported (issue 640): a child of the engine still holding its stderr pipe is ended before it writes its last line, and the log loses what the engine's side printed on its way out.

title: starts no engine while the data is reset, and starts it once the reset has ended
why: A restart that does not ask about the reset (issue 637): its wait ends during a reset of the engine's data and an engine starts on the home whose folders are being removed, writing into them and asked for feeds.list as it settles.

title: starts no engine while the data is reset, and starts it once the reset has ended
why: A restart that found a reset running and never looks again (issue 637): the engine stays restarting after the reset has ended, and only a quit and a reopen start it.

title: leaves no timer and starts nothing once a stop comes during the wait
why: A quit that leaves the restart's timer armed (issue 637): the wait for a reset goes on looking past the stop, held off only by the callback's own check of stopping.

title: refuses a retry while the engine data is being reset, with the reset’s sentence
why: The supervisor's retry not checked against the reset (issue 637): any caller but the bridge, whose own check stands in front, starts an engine on the home whose folders are being removed.

title: has the reset refused while the engine is starting or restarting
why: A reset let through while the engine is restarting (issue 637): nothing is in flight while a restart waits, the reset begins, and the two run together; while starting the handshake refuses it, but as a request being answered, not as the start it is.

title: has the reset refused while the group is being ended
why: A reset let through while what an exited engine left in its group is still being ended (issue 637, from issue 640's review): a tool still running there writes into the folders the reset removes.
